entities.name: Methyl 6-(methylthio)-1H-indole-2-carboxylate
observations: The methyl ester is the functional group transformed in the reaction.

entities.name: 6-(Methylthio)-1H-indole-2-carboxylic acid
observations: Product is formed by hydrolysis of the methyl ester to a carboxylic acid.

entities.name: Methyl ester saponification
observations: The methyl ester C(=O)OCH3 is converted to C(=O)OH; the indole N-H and aryl methyl thioether remain unchanged.
A directly matching empirical record uses NaOH, represented as [Na+].[OH-].

entities.name: Aqueous NaOH hydrolysis with acid workup
observations: Plausible implementation is aqueous or aqueous-alcoholic NaOH hydrolysis, followed by dilute mineral-acid acidification to isolate the free carboxylic acid.
The exact temperature, solvent ratio, and time are not specified by the matching record.
